renderEvidence.continuityMethod: GitHub compare 4d8bb9671b8c394db89d994de75ee4af3ccd578a..0323e898669744ef381093a170d97d29c163bbf7 contains no public/assets/catalog/tops-*.svg changes. Current per-item Git blob SHAs are recorded below.

acceptanceBasis.familyFinding: The Tops are recognizable, original and readable, but the current family is consistently a centered, front-facing flat/vector garment treatment with weak fabric volume, material response and three-quarter collectible presentation. Tier progression relies mostly on motif/color complexity rather than substantially richer construction, materials, lighting and spectacle. This is below the premium dimensional screenshot-match art contract.

items.name: Hoodie
items.reason: Identity is clear and starter-friendly, but card and selected-detail pixels show a flat front-facing garment icon with little believable fabric volume, fold/material response or three-quarter collectible depth. Preserve the simple Hoodie identity while rebuilding it as a dimensional toy-fashion item with stronger form lighting and material cues.

items.name: Zip Hoodie
items.reason: Zip-hoodie identity and pixel motif read, but the garment remains a flat frontal icon. Add dimensional hood/body separation, zipper/hardware depth, fabric folds and three-quarter lighting without overdecorating Tier 1.

items.name: Varsity Tee
items.reason: The tee and varsity/lightning motif are readable, but the presentation is sparse and two-dimensional. Give the shirt convincing body volume, sleeve/collar construction and material shading while keeping a clean starter-tier silhouette.

items.name: Bow Cardigan
items.reason: Bow/cardigan identity is distinct, but knit, button, bow and cuff details read as flat graphic shapes. Rebuild with knit/soft-material depth, layered bow construction and dimensional lighting suitable for Tier 2.

items.name: Crewneck
items.reason: Galaxy emblem is readable, but the sweatshirt has little dimensional construction or material character and feels close to the same front-facing template as adjacent Tops. Preserve the crewneck simplicity while adding garment volume, ribbing/folds and richer galaxy material/light treatment.

items.name: Gamer Jacket
items.reason: Controller/gamer cues are recognizable, but the jacket layering, hardware and textile/tech materials are rendered as flat shapes. Add dimensional collar/panels, seams/hardware and controlled luminous accents while retaining the exact gamer-jacket identity.

items.name: Colorblock Hoodie
items.reason: Colorblocking separates it visually, but Tier 3 still presents as the same flat frontal hoodie family. Add stronger hood/body dimensionality, seams/folds, material variation and three-quarter collectible framing so progression is more than palette/pattern complexity.

items.name: Puffer Vest
items.reason: Vest silhouette is distinct, but the puffer sections do not convincingly read as lofted/quilted material at card scale. Increase cushion volume, panel highlights/shadows, zipper/opening construction and art-theme detail without losing silhouette clarity.

items.name: Art Smock
items.reason: Paint marks/smock identity are present, but construction is flat and apron/smock layering, tools and fabric depth are not premium at Tier 3. Add layered garment form, pocket/tool or paint-material detail and dimensional lighting while preserving the exact Art Smock concept.

items.name: Star Bomber
items.reason: Star/neon bomber cues read, but Tier 4 does not deliver a meaningful jump in material richness or spectacle; it remains another flat jacket card. Rebuild with dimensional bomber volume, ribbed/reflective materials, hardware and restrained neon rim/glow.

items.name: Cloud Jacket
items.reason: Cloud motif and candy palette are readable, but the jacket lacks Tier-4 dimensional construction, plush/material depth and lighting differentiation. Push cloud/plush volume, seams/hardware and candy-luxe material response without obscuring the jacket silhouette.

items.name: Star Coat
items.reason: The long-coat/star concept is recognizable, but the highest tier lacks the luxe construction, dimensional materials, ornament and controlled hero lighting expected of Tier 5. Create a clearly premium coat silhouette with layered lapels/trim, richer material response and spectacular but readable star detail.

handoff.08: Do not treat the current tops-1..12 versions as independently visually accepted. No Tops item from this exact-hash review is eligible for promotion on reviewer-01 evidence; preserve current mappings until replacement versions receive a new hash-bound independent review.
handoff.15: Route Tops repairs in bounded versioned batches to an authorized producer who is not reviewer 01. Preserve current asset versions for comparison. The shared defect is flat frontal/vector treatment below the dimensional collectible target; item-specific repair notes above should control scope.
handoff.next01Review: Continue with bottoms-1..12 unless a replacement Tops batch reaches READY_FOR_REVIEW first; replacement versions take priority.
